headlineOccupancy: sum(used) / sum(capacity) across the same eligible measured sessions
performanceIndex: (cinema used / scope used) / (cinema capacity / scope capacity)
performanceIndexEquivalent: cinema occupancy / scope occupancy when both use identical measured-session eligibility
unknownPolicy: Unavailable measurements are null, never zero.
salesPolicy: Observed public seat state must never be described as confirmed paid ticket sales or admissions.
